description: Cenotaph v1: a rebuilt Instagram patch bundle that ships only features hooked into Instagram's own code. Four patches: runtime, settings app, the DM thread anchor (hooks the root-view handler that resolves the message list) and chat wallpaper (replaces the bitmap in the app's own thread background setter). Built for Instagram 447.0.0.55.81 (385311895) and 439.0.0.37.89 (384510792).

patches.name: Cenotaph - Chat wallpaper hook
patches.description: Feeds Cenotaph's wallpaper into Instagram's own thread background image, where the app sets it.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Runtime (required)
patches.description: Lifecycle hook into Instagram's Application. Every other Cenotaph patch registers here; leave it enabled.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Settings app
patches.description: Adds the Cenotaph Settings launcher icon. It lists only the features this bundle actually hooks.

patches.name: Cenotaph - Thread anchor (required)
patches.description: Hooks the DM thread screen and hands its root view to the other Cenotaph patches. Leave it enabled.

release_notes: Wallpaper is now drawn by Instagram itself: the bundle hooks the app's own thread background setter and substitutes the user's image for the bitmap it is about to hand to its ImageView. New patch "Cenotaph - Chat wallpaper hook" (11 patches total). Thread anchor unchanged.
repoDescription: Cenotaph — standalone Morphe patches for Instagram: chat wallpaper, chat tint, colour map, bubble corners, local font, DM streaks and a theme picker. Built for Instagram 447.0.0.55.81.
